name: Your Heart
overview: Scripture reveals the heart as the wellspring of life and moral action, urging believers to guard it diligently since it shapes the course of their lives (Proverbs 4:23). Jesus commands loving God with all the heart, emphasizing wholehearted devotion (Matthew 22:37), while warning that the heart's condition determines the fruit it produces—good or evil (Matthew 12:35). The heart can be influenced by spiritual forces, as seen in Ananias’ deceit filled by Satan (Acts 5:3), underscoring the need for vigilance and transformation. Believers are called to protect and transform their hearts by embracing God’s words attentively (Proverbs 4:20) and practicing forgiveness (Luke 6:37), reflecting a heart aligned with Christ.
